question: By what source does Viṣṇu accomplish the maintenance of the world?
premises: Viṣṇu is identified as the agent of maintenance.
The own āgama is named as the source or basis.
inference: Viṣṇu performs cosmic maintenance from the own āgama.
plain_english: O daughter of the mountain, Viṣṇu performs the maintenance of the world from one's own āgama.
